crossRefs.note: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous…
He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.
Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

“Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over…
Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

translations.web: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
translations.bsb: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they rejoiced with her.
translations.kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
translations.asv: And her neighbors and her kinsfolk heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy towards her; and they rejoiced with her.
